threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think the local corner shop accepts card payments. Good luck with that when the cash-only queues start.
Saw a bloke in a suit on the 277 last night, loudly debating the ethics of pineapple on pizza. Had the whole back row in stitches.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The smell of fresh falafel wafting through the streets on a Saturday evening, mixed with the laughter from families at the parks. That’s when it hit me.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg do you find a late-night Späti selling fresh currywurst, but only if you order it in German. It’s a culinary rite of passage.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local by their instinct to avoid any BART delays. They know the best taco trucks to hit during rush hour instead.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 47 bus today—driver had his playlist blasting 90s hip-hop. Passengers were dancing in the aisles like it was a nightclub on wheels.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think the best tapas are at fancy places, but the hidden gems are in the tiny bars where the old locals gather over vermut.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the way they still check their Google Maps for a street that’s been there for decades. A true Gràcia local knows the shortcuts.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think wearing a parka in summer is a fashion statement. Everyone else is in shorts, drinking craft beer on the pavement.
Spotted a guy on the 47 loudly reciting Shakespeare to a half-asleep crowd. Everyone pretended not to listen until the encore of Hamlet’s soliloquy.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The day I saw a kid selling homemade lemonade on the corner of Richardstraße, while a busker played 'Wonderwall' nearby. Classic Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: In Friedrichshain, it’s common to see street artists using public transport as a stage—performing on trams while commuters pretend to ignore them.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a true local when they know to avoid BART during rush hour, especially with all the brake problems lately. Tourists just stand there, confused.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy juggling at the 16th St BART while the train was delayed, completely unbothered by the chaos. Just another day in the Mission.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think the parks are just for lounging, but we use them for morning markets and impromptu concerts too. It’s a different vibe.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the way they still ask for 'tap water' at restaurants instead of just asking for a 'carafeta.' It's a dead giveaway.
